data.description: The Luxury Swing is the simpler of our two canopy swings. Its slatted wooden bench hangs from a straight steel A-frame, and a red pitched canopy runs along the top bar. With splayed legs and no side rails, it has a lighter look on a small lawn or a terrace garden. Older residents, couples and parents waiting for children all use a swing like this, so it fits housing societies, hotel gardens and club lawns. It sits in our CoreCraft garden decor range with a listed colour of Sand Beige. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the quote. Tell us where you want it and we will check the clearance on your layout drawing.

items.pText: The Luxury Swing is the simpler of our two canopy swings. Its slatted wooden bench hangs from a straight steel A-frame, and a red pitched canopy runs along the top bar. With splayed legs and no side rails, it has a lighter look on a small lawn or a terrace garden. Older residents, couples and parents waiting for children all use a swing like this, so it fits housing societies, hotel gardens and club lawns. It sits in our CoreCraft garden decor range with a listed colour of Sand Beige. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the quote. Tell us where you want it and we will check the clearance on your layout drawing.

Swing chains and their top fixings should be inspected regularly, since a worn link or loose shackle is the usual fault on any hanging seat. The A-frame legs spread wide, so we mark their footprint before deciding on self-standing or grouted installation. Oil the hanging points before the monsoon and check the canopy bolts after strong wind.
